approved_tools.name: Blocks for Buildings
approved_tools.purpose: The child picks wooden blocks for the roof, pillars and base of the buildings in the opening picture, builds the model and finds how it is like and unlike the real building.

approved_tools.name: Prism or Pyramid
approved_tools.purpose: The child taps the faces of prisms and pyramids to find the rectangle faces all prisms share and the triangle faces that meet at one point in every pyramid, and decides if a cube is also a prism.

approved_tools.name: Faces, Corners and Edges
approved_tools.purpose: The child counts the faces, corners and edges of straw and clay solids, fills the F, V and E table, works out F+V−E and sorts the solids by flat faces and straight edges.

approved_tools.name: Opposite Faces
approved_tools.purpose: The child turns a die and a coloured cube to find the face opposite a face and the faces that share an edge with it.

approved_tools.name: Spot the Faces
approved_tools.purpose: The child marks everyday objects by their faces and corners: rectangular face, triangular face, curved face, no corner and the same opposite faces.

approved_tools.name: Sort the Solids
approved_tools.purpose: The child drags solids into two circles by a rule, such as curved or straight edges, and into overlapping circles to find the solids that belong to both sets.

approved_tools.name: Build and Draw Cubes
approved_tools.purpose: The child copies cube models from unit cubes, counts the cubes in a tower layer by layer including the hidden ones, and completes cube drawings on triangular dot paper.

approved_tools.name: Solid Riddles
approved_tools.purpose: The child reads clues about faces, corners and edges, and about straws and clay balls, and picks or builds the solid that fits each clue.
approved_tools.flow_row: Name the solid from its clues (C8, C23)

approved_tools.name: Fold the Net
approved_tools.purpose: The child folds nets into solids, matches nets to solids, tests which nets fold into a given solid and finds the solid whose net has the given pieces.

approved_tools.name: When Lines Meet
approved_tools.purpose: The child makes an angle by meeting two straws at a point, then marks and counts the angles in pictures and in a classroom scene.

approved_tools.name: Right Angle Checker
approved_tools.purpose: The child folds paper into a right angle checker, uses it to test corners of shapes and objects, and draws right angles on a dot grid.

approved_tools.name: Acute or Obtuse
approved_tools.purpose: The child swings a line against a right angle to see if an angle is acute or obtuse, draws both kinds on a dot grid and colours angles red, green and blue.

approved_tools.name: Push the Straw Shapes
approved_tools.purpose: The child builds a triangle and a rectangle from straws and clay, pushes one side and sees that the triangle keeps its shape while the rectangle does not.
approved_tools.flow_row: Push the triangle and the rectangle (C13)

approved_tools.name: Angles After the Push
approved_tools.purpose: The child pushes a rectangle, a square and a pentagon and reads how the angles change: the right angles of the rectangle and square become acute and obtuse.

approved_tools.name: Angles in Shapes
approved_tools.purpose: The child draws three- and four-sided shapes on a dot grid, counts their right angles, compares rectangle and square with other four-sided shapes and finds a shape from its kinds of angles.

approved_tools.name: Make a Circle
approved_tools.purpose: The child places equal straws around a centre and marks points at an equal distance from a point A to see that every point of a circle is the same distance from its centre.

approved_tools.name: Fold the Circle
approved_tools.purpose: The child folds a circle in half in different ways, sees that the creases are equal and meet at the centre, and finds that the diameter is double the radius.

approved_tools.name: Find Radius and Diameter
approved_tools.purpose: The child draws a compass flower, marks the centre, radius and diameter on a carpet design and compares four wheels by radius and diameter.

approved_tools.name: Sides and Angles
approved_tools.purpose: The child sorts flat shape cards by their sides and shapes by their number of angles, sees that the two counts match and draws shapes with fewer and more than five angles.
approved_tools.flow_row: Sort by sides and angles (C20, C24)

approved_tools.name: Divide the Shapes
approved_tools.purpose: The child spots hidden shapes and draws lines to divide a triangle, a square and other shapes into smaller shapes.

approved_tools.name: Spider Web Puzzles
approved_tools.purpose: The child counts the triangles and rectangles in the two webs and traces walks that use no wall twice to find which walks are possible.

approved_tools.name: Matchstick Moves
approved_tools.purpose: The child makes, moves and removes matchsticks to form 2, 4 and 3 triangles.
